title: Optimal Pathways: A Distributed Messaging Network
author: David Riva
long_description:
Designed and implemented a distributed network of N nodes capable of routing packets based on Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm in a simulated network topology.
Implemented communication between nodes using the TCP/IP model, facilitating packet exchange through a custom marshalling and demarshalling system.
Optimized performance by introducing multi-threading for parallel message sending and receiving within each node in the system.
short_description: A distributed network simulation where nodes route packets using Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm.

title: Trip Planning Application
author: David Riva & CS314 [Software Development] Teammates
long_description:
Designed and implemented a comprehensive trip planning and optimization application as a full-stack developer.
Integrated and utilized multiple RESTful APIs across the application's stack to enhance its functionalities.
Demonstrated proficiency in Agile methodologies by following Scrum practices, leading meetings with a team of 4 other students.
Ensured deployment and documentation of the product through bi-monthly releases, ensuring clear and accessible information for users & stakeholders.
short_description: A full-stack application for planning and optimizing trips, integrating multiple RESTful APIs.

title: Sorting Algorithms Visualization
author: David Riva
long_description: An application that visualizes different sorting algorithms in real-time across random data points. Allows the user to add data points, randomize all data points, select the algorithm to use, step through the sorting algorithm in real-time, and sort all the data points automatically.
short_description: An interactive tool that visualizes various sorting algorithms in real time.

title: Email Templating Utility Tool
author: David Riva
long_description: A Next.js application that allows users to complete a form, which automatically generates a pre-written email in Outlook based on their input. The project was later converted into an Electron.js application for easy distribution, enabling users to add it to their favorites for quick access. It leverages inter-process communication to directly launch Outlook on the user's computer and load the email template seamlessly.
short_description: A Next.js and Electron.js application that generates pre-written emails in Outlook based on user input.
